description: This file contains implementation of functions and classes for converting frozen PyTorch JIT operations to MKLDNN optimized subgraphs, including subgraph slicing, operator registration, and graph rewriting for MKLDNN compatibility.

classes.name: MKLDNNSubgraphSlicer
classes.description: Class responsible for slicing and merging subgraphs for MKLDNN optimization within a graph block.

methods.name: getLastUse
methods.description: Finds the last node that uses a given value.

methods.name: merge_sets
methods.description: Merges two aliasing sets in the alias mapping.

methods.name: assertNonTensorTypeDoesNotContainTensors
methods.description: Asserts that a type does not contain tensor types.

methods.name: InplaceMKLDNNSubgraph
methods.description: Performs in-place optimization of MKLDNN subgraphs by alias analysis and node merging.

methods.name: CreateUnaryOp
methods.description: Creates an operation that unpacks MKLDNN tensors into contiguous tensors for aten operations.

methods.name: BroadOp
methods.description: Creates a broadcast operation for MKLDNN tensors.

methods.name: ConstantMKLDNNTensorOp
methods.description: Creates a constant MKLDNN tensor operation.

methods.name: mkldnn_tensor_scalar_mul
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication on MKLDNN tensors.

methods.name: replaceInputWithMKLDNN
methods.description: Replaces a node's input with its MKLDNN version.

methods.name: moveConvWeightsToMKLDNN
methods.description: Reorders convolution weights for MKLDNN compatibility.

methods.name: moveWeightsToMKLDNN
methods.description: Converts weights in nodes to MKLDNN format where applicable.

methods.name: clamp_node_creator
methods.description: Creates clamp nodes with specified min and max values.

methods.name: ComputeSubgraphInMKLDNN
methods.description: Converts a subgraph node into an MKLDNN-optimized subgraph.

methods.name: shouldConsiderForMerge
methods.description: Determines if a node should be considered for MKLDNN subgraph merging.

methods.name: scanNode
methods.description: Scans a node for MKLDNN group merging opportunities.

methods.name: tryMerge
methods.description: Attempts to merge a consumer node into a producer MKLDNN group.

methods.name: containsMKLDNNGroup
methods.description: Checks if a block contains MKLDNN groups.
